objective: Perform a safe first real build batch: inspect the current application architecture, improve the autonomous builder execution layer and its validation/reporting where needed, and leave the repository in a clearly reviewable state without changing production application behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Runner configuration remains explicit and bounded.
No automatic merge to main is possible from the runner contract.
No new paid storage service is provisioned.
Build and relevant verification commands pass before READY_FOR_REVIEW.
All changes remain on the isolated batch branch.
A machine-readable report identifies changed files, checks, failures, and review status.
stopConditions: verification command fails outside permitted scope
attempt to modify main or deploy production
agent proposes work outside the batch objective
